summary: Customer-service-oriented candidate with about 4 years of combined experience across delivery dispatch, medical office administration and construction labor. Managed a bicycle and tricycle delivery spoke route, handling order picking, loading, cyclist dispatch, and daily delivery reporting to warehouse management. Background in front-desk operations, patient billing data, appointment scheduling and facility open/close and safety procedures. Early construction exposure on residential, commercial and hotel renovation projects under a licensed contractor. Holds an associate degree in general studies and brings Microsoft Office proficiency.
